title: Gender and Political Bias in Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model accuracy on a zero-shot gender classification task using parliamentary debate speeches, and measuring performance disparities in a vote prediction task by applying gender perturbations to the prompts (e.g., omitting, swapping, or universally applying male/female identity cues).

Simulating legislative voting behavior based on debate content and evaluating prediction accuracy disparities across different European Parliament political groups along the ideological spectrum (from far-left to far-right), with and without explicit group identifiers.

Qualitative error analysis of high-confidence model misclassifications, demonstrating a disproportionate rate of gender misclassification for older politicians (age > 70) due to traditional speech patterns.
